description: Add the `x-goog-request-params` routing header to the Datastore data-plane operations. Requests to a named database are rejected without it (HTTP 400 'Missing routing header').

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Routing header `project_id={project}&database_id={database}`. Required for named (non-default) databases; the API rejects requests to them without it (HTTP 400 'Missing routing header').
